edits.after: Many of education's most visible achievements belong to this category.
edits.reason: Removes duplicated most and keeps source's broad category claim.
edits.before: Most of education's most visible achievements belong to this category.

edits.after: Parents worry that children lack direction, so they offer a complete route: first accomplish the immediate goal, then move to the next stage, build up better opportunities and resources, and ultimately achieve a stable and successful life.
edits.reason: Naturalizes accumulate better conditions without changing the planned sequence.
edits.before: Parents worry that children lack direction, so they offer a complete route: first accomplish the immediate goal, then enter the next stage, accumulate better conditions, and ultimately obtain a stable and successful life.

edits.after: Such responses may seem less powerful than definite answers, but they leave the child an important role: not someone collecting a manual for life, but someone who will need to keep working out answers for themselves.
edits.reason: 亲自 means for themselves, not physically in person; retains open-ended responsibility.
edits.before: Such responses seem less powerful than definite answers, but they preserve an important position for the child: not someone collecting a manual for life, but someone who will later need to continue answering in person.

edits.after: A los padres les preocupa que su hijo carezca de dirección y le ofrecen un recorrido completo: alcanzar primero el objetivo inmediato, pasar después a la siguiente etapa, reunir más recursos y oportunidades y conseguir finalmente una vida estable y exitosa.
edits.reason: Naturalizes reunir mejores condiciones without dropping any stage or purpose.
edits.before: A los padres les preocupa que su hijo carezca de dirección y le ofrecen un recorrido completo: alcanzar primero el objetivo inmediato, entrar después en la siguiente etapa, reunir mejores condiciones y obtener finalmente una vida estable y exitosa.

edits.after: También consiste en crear las condiciones para que crezca aquello que no se puede transmitir directamente.
edits.reason: Replaces dejar condiciones and introducir awkwardness with the same indirect-development meaning.
edits.before: También consiste en dejar condiciones para aquello que no puede introducirse directamente.

edits.after: For example, a child asks, “If everyone dies in the end, why bother doing so many things?”
edits.reason: Makes the child's existential why natural rather than the unidiomatic why do so many things.
edits.before: For example, a child asks, “If everyone dies in the end, why do so many things?”

edits.after: “Would you like me to tell you what I know, or would you rather talk about what's on your mind right now?”
edits.reason: Natural child-directed dialogue; preserves information versus expression distinction.
edits.before: “Would you like me to tell you what I know, or do you more want to talk about what you're thinking right now?”

edits.after: But experience cannot tell the whole story of a child's future before that future has unfolded.
edits.reason: Removes academic as-yet-unfolded construction while preserving the limit of adult experience.
edits.before: But experience cannot narrate the child's as-yet-unfolded future to its conclusion in advance.

edits.after: Si pregunta «¿qué debería hacer de mayor?», los padres pueden ayudarlo a ver capacidades, condiciones y consecuencias. Pero una respuesta completa que llegue demasiado pronto también puede impedirle seguir distinguiendo qué actividades lo atraen una y otra vez por sí mismas y cuáles sigue solo porque la persona en quien más confía ha señalado ese camino como el correcto.
edits.reason: Clarifies recurrent intrinsic attraction versus following the trusted adult's designation; no new thesis.
edits.before: Si pregunta «¿qué debería hacer de mayor?», los padres pueden ayudarlo a ver capacidades, condiciones y consecuencias. Pero una respuesta completa que llegue demasiado pronto también puede impedirle seguir distinguiendo qué hace porque vuelve a ello de verdad y qué hace solo porque la persona en quien más confía ha llamado correcto a ese camino.

edits.after: This keeps questions from being punished without letting them become a tool for endless negotiation.
edits.reason: Repairs punishing questions grammatical awkwardness; retains both safeguards.
edits.before: This prevents both punishing questions and turning them into a tool of endless negotiation.

edits.reason: Idiomatic dismissal corresponding to source, rather than literal claim that there are not many whys.

edits.after: Children also learn to notice other people through the small details of everyday life.
edits.reason: Naturalizes seeing other people reaches children; preserves attention to others rather than literal visual perception.
edits.before: Seeing other people also reaches children mainly through everyday details.

edits.after: Whether they make these possibilities their own, and how they do so, will depend on their own lives.
edits.reason: Removes must enter their lives calque while retaining non-copying and independent uptake.
edits.before: Whether and how they adopt it later must still enter their own lives.

edits.after: Será en su propia vida donde decida si hace suyas esas posibilidades y de qué manera.
edits.reason: Repairs awkward sentence structure; retains child's eventual independent use.
edits.before: Si utilizará esas posibilidades y cómo lo hará tendrán que entrar después en su propia vida.

edits.after: Pero lo que pueden asumir y hacer tampoco se limita a las palabras.
edits.reason: Source says responsibility extends beyond speech, not that words impose a limit on what parents can bear.
edits.before: Pero también pueden asumir más de lo que permiten las palabras.

edits.after: One adult becomes the strict parent; the other offers comfort and waives the rules. Children encounter boundaries with the former and seek exceptions from the latter. Over time, family roles become fixed: one person has to be the bad one, while the other gains closeness by protecting the child.
edits.reason: Naturalizes releases the rules and fixed good-parent/bad-parent arrangement, retaining all steps.
edits.before: One adult becomes the strict parent; the other provides comfort and releases the rules. Children encounter boundaries with the former and seek exceptions from the latter. Over time, family roles become fixed: one person is responsible for being the bad one, while the other gains closeness by protecting the child.

edits.after: It means being open to the possibility that what another person says could change your mind. Even if it does not, you can still recognize their reason for what it is, rather than dismiss it as mere emotion, a character flaw, or a nuisance.
edits.reason: Repairs allowing what another says the possibility syntax while preserving genuine reason even without agreement.
edits.before: It is allowing what another says the possibility of changing oneself, while, even if no change results, accurately acknowledging it as a real reason rather than reducing it to emotion, character, or nuisance.

edits.after: Estas frases cargan sobre el niño una comunicación que los adultos no han completado. Empezará a gestionar las emociones de sus padres y a ajustar lo que dice para evitar que empeore la relación.
edits.reason: Disambiguates sus emociones: child starts managing the parents' emotions, not merely their own.
edits.before: Estas frases cargan sobre el niño una comunicación que los adultos no han completado. Empezará a gestionar sus emociones y ajustar lo que dice para evitar que empeore la relación.

edits.after: El niño también observa si los adultos permiten que el otro cambie de opinión.
edits.reason: Source means allowing the other to change, not causing mutual transformation.
edits.before: El niño también observa si los adultos se permiten cambiar mutuamente.

review_scope.method: Read every Chinese, English and Spanish paragraph from the formal incoming ZIP, comparing meaning, argument, examples and qualifications; checked paragraph alignment against supplied Markdown. Local edits preserve paragraph positions and complete argument.
review_scope.limitations: Editorial and cross-language review, not independent empirical verification of every general claim. No site files edited or incoming scripts executed.
